class.name: NetwSessionConfig
class.description: Set the values in [method Object._init]. They are applied once, at the end of the frame, and changes after that push a warning and do nothing. [codeblock] func _init() -> void: Netw.configure_session(self) \ .app(&"bomber-v2") \ .role(NetwMultiplayer.ROLE_LISTEN_SERVER) [/codeblock] A preset passed to [method Netw.configure_session] is copied, so one [code].tres[/code] can be used by several scenes. When no node calls [method Netw.configure_session], the settings of the [MultiplayerTree] are used. When one does, the [MultiplayerTree] settings are ignored.

method.name: app
method.description: Sets [member app_id] and returns this config.

method.name: link
method.description: Sets [member link_conditions] and returns this config.

method.name: role
method.description: Sets [member desired_role] and returns this config.

method.name: server
method.description: Sets [member server_info] and returns this config.

members.member: The game and build. Peers with a different [member app_id] cannot connect. Leave it empty to accept any. WebRTC room codes are also created per [member app_id].

The role this peer takes when it hosts, which becomes [member NetwMultiplayer.role]. A server made with [method MultiplayerTree.raise_embedded_server] is always [constant NetwMultiplayer.ROLE_DEDICATED_SERVER].
Simulated latency and packet loss for testing. Copied when applied.

What this server shows in server browsers. The player count and [member NetwServerInfo.app_id] are filled in automatically. Copied when applied. [codeblock] var info := NetwServerInfo.new() info.motd = "Friday night" info.max_players = 8 Netw.configure_session(self).server(info) [/codeblock] To change it for each request, use [method Netw.configure_server_info].
